name: syncflow-studio
description: Multi-platform video scheduler, hybrid pre-upload dispatcher, and platform-tailored metadata studio

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@clipflow/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=@clipflow/server" "npm run dev --workspace=@clipflow/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@clipflow/shared && npm run build --workspace=@clipflow/server && npm run build --workspace=@clipflow/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@clipflow/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@clipflow/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@clipflow/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@clipflow/shared && npx tsx --test packages/shared/test/*.test.ts apps/server/test/*.test.ts
